hostGlueImports._why: Planted imports for hostGlueImportedBySlices: a slice that imported the host glue could build the writable store itself. A test file, by package.json's test glob, is no slice and may import glue (#26); a file that only looks like one is still a slice. A coincidences.ts is no slice either: it never runs, only another coincidences.ts imports one, and its shape is pinned (#289 r=3, Addendum 2); a file of another name in the same folder is still a slice, so the pair shares one folder.
